item.description: The ClockDomain class lacks a proper __eq__ method, causing two ClockDomain objects with identical properties to not be recognized as equal in DomainLookupTestCase. This leads to test failures when comparing ClockDomain instances.
item.contract: Implement an __eq__ method in the ClockDomain class that properly compares ClockDomain objects based on their properties (name, clk_edge, reset_less, async_reset, local) rather than object identity. The method should return True when two ClockDomain objects have identical properties, False otherwise.

item.description: Simulator processes are returning None when they should be returning valid tick operations, causing AttributeError when trying to call methods like .tick() on None. This affects multiple simulator regression tests.
item.contract: Ensure that simulator processes properly handle and return tick operations instead of returning None. When a Tick command is issued, the simulator should return a valid Tick object that supports the expected interface (.tick(), .set(), etc.).

item.description: Memory operations in RTLIL backend tests are failing due to missing or incomplete memory initialization handling. Tests like test_async_read and test_sync_read are failing, indicating issues with how memory data is processed and converted to RTLIL format.
item.contract: Fix memory initialization and read/write operations in the RTLIL backend conversion process. Ensure that memory data is properly handled during conversion to RTLIL format, including proper initialization of memory contents and correct handling of read/write operations.
